title: Personas
profTagline: Made-up people from your audience you can question. Say who the idea is for and get people with photos, money and habits, talk to each one and compare who would pay how much.
installDesc: Opens like an app, from your home screen
installIosHint: In Safari: tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
installGenericHint: In the browser menu choose Install or Add to Home screen.
whoHint: a TikTok zoomer who makes anime edits
note: Made-up people are hypotheses, not proof. Check with real ones.
amz2: What is the customer's problem or opportunity?
amz3: What is the most important benefit for them?
amz4: How do you know what they need?
amz5: What does their experience look like from start to finish?
emptyPeople: Write one line — who your idea is for — and people you can question will appear here.
emptyCompare: The comparison lands here: what each person said about the idea and how much they would pay.
qLast: When did you last do something like this? Tell me how it went.
qSpent: What did you last spend money on, and how much?
qHides: What do you hide from others?
qPrice: How many Telegram Stars a month would you pay for this? And how many is too many?
pitchQ: Look, here is an idea: {idea}. Honestly, what do you think?
askHint: Ask about the past, not the future
noQuote: Has not seen the idea yet
eSignIn: Sign in to gather people and question them.
eCrowd: No people came out. Try again or put it differently.
eMesh: No 3D came out of this portrait.
eBusy: All 3D machines are busy. Try again in a minute.
eOneAtATime: One 3D model at a time — wait for the last one.
eRate: Too many requests. Wait a little.
eFailed: That did not work. Try again.
eModelView: The model would not open on this phone.
replaceBody: The current people and your talks with them will be gone.
